episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the critical importance of consistent client communication to prevent losing deals. He also explores the role of AI in real estate, emphasizing that while AI can enhance efficiency, it won't replace the need for personal connections and emotional intelligence. The episode provides actionable insights for agents to improve client retention and leverage technology effectively.
